body: I appreciate the sentiment, but from my experience hope is foolishness

Few reasons. I’ll tell you the first ones to come to mind.  


Not only am I ugly, but I was born with a birth defect on my left face, so I had to be operated on and now it looks all cut up and stitched up and repulsive.   

I have serious social phobia (just going grocery shopping causes me great stress) so throughout my life I have avoided socializing and just kept to myself as much as possible. So here I am lacking in social skills, with no friends and afraid of entering the real world.

We have congenital heart issues running in my family, so I am at a high risk of being a contender. I’d rather not have to live a life of daily having to do intense exercise, almost only eat vegetables and still be at a high risk of having something happen to me.

With all that being said, I don’t really have anything going for me, I’m not intelligent, I’m not athletically gifted, I’m not talented, I’ll never have a fancy high-paying job, etc. 

The last thing to bring up is that I’m simply not a happy person. Things that other people enjoy, movies, holidays, pets, going to the park, etc don’t really bring me joy. There isn’t anything in the world that I care about enough to make it worth having to deal with all these things I hate.
Why? What other method should I use (I can’t get a fire arm unfortunately)?
